method: vanishing_points (independent implementation 40_lines_indep; VP MLE per direction group, f from orthogonality)
model: fx=fy, zero skew; pp = distortion centre of the plumb-line fit (k1,k2, centre free); f from cart-X _|_ cart-vertical of both carts (common vertical from the posts of both carts); pp NOT determinable from the vanishing points alone

uncertainty.how: stratified bootstrap (300): cart-X members and all non-VP edges resampled by cluster, members of the small groups (posts, scene verticals) rotated by a random direction error (sigma_psi from the redundancy of the cart-X groups); plumb-line distortion AND centre re-estimated in every replicate, then VPs and f; HEADLINE 1-sigma = statistical (+) systematic in quadrature (review): systematic = half-range of the central values over the credible variants (radial model k1k2 / k1k2k3 / division-2; the two visible pieces of the blue floor line treated separately or as one straight line; straightness weighting), see details.review; *_stat / *_sys kept

data_used: 58 verified straight_3d edges (mean of the 7 jitter-corrected stills; files edges_cart310/cart80/scene.json, reviewed=True); duplicates removed; rejected as curved: cart80_x_A_front_in, cart80_x_E_front, cart80_x_E_front_in; VP groups: 310X (9 edges / 7 members), 80X (7/6), cart posts 310Z+80Z (4), scene verticals (5, not used for f)
geometry_assumptions: no dimensions; cart X axes perpendicular to the cart posts; both carts' posts parallel (upright on one floor)

pp_fixed_image_centre.note: with the centre-fixed plumb-line distortion (k1k2) and pp = image centre

notes: floor-line groups (FA along / FC across the aisle) are inconsistent with the vertical (chi2 350-550 for 4 dof) -> not used
end-board groups give pp-free solutions that swing with the distortion variant (f 49..1475) -> not used

pp free is under-determined with the structural pairs; if the distortion centre is kept fixed while pp moves ('mixed', details.f_of_ppy) f changes ~1.7 px per px of pp_y, but for the OpenCV-consistent model (distortion centre = pp) f is almost independent of pp_y (details.pp_scan: 1469..1503 for pp_y 340..660)
self-consistent pairs (distortion centre = pp) give f 1479-1490 for all plumb variants (centre fixed or free, poly or division)

summary: numbers reproduced; no code bug that changes the results

principal point / distortion-centre height is NOT determined to the bootstrap sd: it moves with the radial model and with the floor-line assumption (range of the credible variants: y = 426..512); x is determined to ~+-10 px

blue floor line (one painted line visible left of cart 310 and between the carts): with the main lens the piece between the carts lies +10.1 px off the straight line through the left piece and is rotated by 1.12 deg; with the pieces merged into one straight edge the free distortion centre moves to y ~510 without cost for the other edges (k1k2k3)
focal length is robust to these variants (half-range 8.6 px for this method)

stratified leave-one-VP-member-out jackknife (joint): sd f/cx/cy = [30.9, 3.4, 13.0] (bootstrap [20.6, 4.5, 22.0]); jackknife calibrated on synthetic data is ~unbiased but very noisy (8..37 px for a true 21.6 px)
cart split (joint, common vertical): cart-310 X only f = 1440, cart-80 X only f = 1489

budget.rule: systematic 1-sigma = half-range of the central values over the credible variants (main included); mapping: half of the largest median rotation-compensated displacement vs the main in the region

alternative_floorline_merged.model: ALTERNATIVE (review): as the main model, but the two visible pieces of the blue floor line (left of cart 310 / between the carts) are one straight 3D line (assumption: one straight painted line under cart 310)

uncertainty.how: no separate bootstrap; see the main entry
